title: Plan gifts for everyone on your list and hit every order-by date
summary: Tell your bot who's on your list, what each person is into and what you want to spend. It suggests a few ideas per person, keeps one tracker of what's picked, ordered, arrived and wrapped, and nudges you each week before the shipping cut-offs, so nobody gets missed and nothing arrives after the holiday.
what_the_bot_does: Asks for each person's name, age, interests and your budget for them (or splits one total for you).
Suggests 2 or 3 ideas per person (something useful, something fun, an experience) with a link to look at each one.
Builds one tracker: person, idea, link, price, ordered, arrived, wrapped, given, with a running total against your budget.
Notes the latest order date for each item so it arrives in time, and sets reminders a few days before each one.
Checks in once a week until your last shopping day with who still needs a gift and anything over budget. You buy everything yourself.
what_you_end_up_with: One list with ideas for everyone, a running total, and a weekly 'still to buy' note, instead of ideas scattered across screenshots, notes and open tabs, and a gift that turns up on December 27.

tools.note: Free gift-list templates exist (ideas per person, budget, shipping cut-offs); one user's first bot built a 10-ideas-per-person dashboard with order-by dates
Tasks in Gemini can compare products and set reminders; in the US it can also check out with Google Pay, but ask it not to
A dot can keep the tracker and check in on a schedule
Any chat assistant can do the ideas and the table; you keep the list up to date yourself

prompt:
Help me plan holiday gifts. Here's my list: [name, age, what they're into, budget each, e.g. Mum, 67, gardening and crime novels, $60]. My total is [total budget] and I live in [country].

For each person suggest 3 ideas (one useful, one fun, one experience) with a link and a rough price, and the latest date to order so it arrives by [date]. Add a few small extras for [teachers / neighbours / hosts].

Keep one tracker with: person, idea, link, price, ordered, arrived, wrapped, given, and a running total against my budget. Every [Saturday at 10 a.m.] until [last shopping date], send me who still needs a gift, what's late and anything over budget. Remind me 3 days before each order-by date.

Don't buy anything, don't sign in to any store, and don't share anyone's details. I'll order myself from the links and tell you when something is bought.
setup: Pick one assistant that can run on a schedule and send you reminders: a Grok Bot, a ChatGPT dot or Tasks in Gemini. A plain chat works too if you only want the ideas and the table.
Write your list first: first names, ages, a few words on what each person likes, and what you want to spend. Set your total yourself before you ask for ideas.
Paste the prompt with your list, your country (for shops and delivery dates) and the day you want to be finished.
Push back on ideas that miss ('she already has every kitchen gadget, try experiences') and pick one per person.
Each time you order something, tell the bot ('bought Mum's book, $24'), so the total and the weekly check-in stay right.
watch_out: Order-by dates and prices from a bot are a guide. Check the shop's own delivery cut-off and price before you order (BAARP; the todo.is prompt says the same).
Keep it to first names and interests. Don't paste anyone's home address, card numbers or account logins into the chat (BAARP).
Some gift bots also watch for price drops or fill carts. If yours does, keep the 'never buy without my yes' rule and a spending cap.
AI ideas can be generic. You know the nephew who collects old maps; use the list as a starting point, not the final word.

sources.label: X post by @ShannonMFHill (2026-11-24): 'Made my first Grok Bot! This bot organizes your holiday gift list' and checks daily for price drops; shared for others to use (15 likes / 6 reposts / 4 replies / 400 views, measured 2026-11-25)

BAARP, 'Plan Your Holiday Gift List and Budget With AI' by Carla Jennings (2026-11-09): split one total per person, three ideas each in budget, a Name / Budget / Gift idea / Where to buy / Actual price / Bought tracker, and check prices, shipping and returns on the store's own site

todo.is prompt page, 'Christmas gift list with ideas, links and a budget for everyone': 3 ideas per person with the latest order date for Christmas delivery, an ordered / arrived / wrapped tracker, a Saturday reminder until your last shopping date, and 'Don't buy anything for me'

Grokbot Agents directory, 'Holiday Gift List & Secret Santa Shopper' free Grok Bot template (updated 2026-11-10): one budget split across the list, good / better / best ideas, shipping cut-offs with reminders 3 days before, delivery and returns-by tracking; you approve every purchase

X post by @BurnsZA (2026-11-24): a Grok Bot that finds 10 gift ideas for everyone on the list, all within budget, on one dashboard with photos and order-by dates (0 likes / 29 views, measured 2026-11-25)

Reddit r/Gifts, 'How do you keep track of gift ideas for people throughout the year?' (2026-04-18): ideas get forgotten between March and July; top answer is a sheet with name, occasion, ideas, purchased and total (1 point / 54 comments as shown)
